cases.title: Conductometric strong-acid titration: a minimum, not only an endpoint
cases.original_expected_result: Conductivity falls as highly mobile hydrogen ions are replaced by sodium ions, reaches a minimum near equivalence, and rises with excess hydroxide.

original.criterion: The equivalence snapshot has lower conductivity than both the initial acid and final excess-base snapshots.

criteria.evidence: Equivalence conductivity 1204.28016648 < initial 4058.45669281 and excess-base 2359.45573764 uS/cm.

original.criterion: pH crosses from acidic to near-neutral to alkaline; conductivity does not become zero.

criteria.evidence: Measured pH [2.038105470481, 6.992693453276, 11.63545549958]; equivalence near neutral, subsequent base alkaline; all conductivities positive.

ledger.scope: Whole-script represented portions, literal additions, diluted water, trapped boundary air and explicit gas transfers. No measured-field/solution/lot double counting. Not an energy ledger.

cases.title: Weak-acid conductometric titration distinguishes neutralisation from dilution
cases.original_expected_result: Formation of sodium acetate increases the mobile-ion inventory; after equivalence, excess hydroxide gives a steeper conductivity rise.

original.criterion: Conductivity at equivalence exceeds its initial weak-acid value.

criteria.evidence: Equivalence 475.05754749 > initial 145.202848858 uS/cm.

original.criterion: The final equal-size base addition gives a stronger conductivity response than an equal-size addition well before equivalence; inspect actual volumes.

criteria.evidence: Final 0.5 mmol addition raises conductivity by 1162.2639 uS/cm versus 226.8608 for the preceding 0.5 mmol ending AT equivalence. Earlier well-before-equivalence increments are 0.25 mmol each, not the single equal-size addition specified. Normalised slope supports forecast but does not supply missing matched single-dose control.

ledger.scope: Whole-script represented portions, literal additions, diluted water, trapped boundary air and explicit gas transfers. No measured-field/solution/lot double counting. Not an energy ledger.

notes: Freeze a separate matched early/final 0.5 mmol-control design, or retain only C1; do not revise the original criterion after observation.
